description_en: Retrieves details for a specified experiment group
description_zh: 获取指定实验组的详细信息
name: GetExperimentGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment group. You can call the `ListExperimentGroups` operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 实验组ID，可通过接口ListExperimentGroups获取
parameters.name: experiment_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the `ListInstances` operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Config.description_en: The configuration of the experiment group

CrowdTargetType.description_en:
The method for targeting traffic to the experiment group. Valid values:

`All`: all traffic

`Filter`: traffic that matches the filter

`CrowdId`: traffic from the specified crowd

`Random`: a random percentage of traffic
CrowdTargetType.description_zh:
实验组流量定向的类型，可能的取值包括：
All  所有的流量
Filter 使用过滤条件的流量
CrowdId 通过指定人群ID
Random 按照百分比随机流量

DebugCrowdId.description_en: The ID of the debug crowd

DebugUsers.description_en: The user IDs for debugging, separated by commas
DebugUsers.description_zh: 调试用户，多个用户间用逗号作间隔

Description.description_en: The description of the experiment group

DistributionType.description_en:
The traffic distribution method.
● `UserId`: Distributes traffic by user ID.
● `TimeDuration`: Distributes traffic by time period
DistributionType.description_zh:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段
DistributionType.title_en:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段
DistributionType.title_zh:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段

HoldingBuckets.description_en: The bucket IDs that correspond to the `RandomFlow` percentage. This parameter is returned only when `CrowdTargetType` is set to `Random`
HoldingBuckets.description_zh: 当实验组流量定向的类型是Random时，根据随机流量RandomFlow大小，返回的具体的桶号

Name.description_en: The name of the experiment group

NeedAA.description_en: Indicates whether an A/B test is required

Owner.description_en: The owner of the experiment group

RandomFlow.description_en: The percentage of traffic from 0 to 100 that is randomly allocated to this experiment group. This parameter is returned only when `CrowdTargetType` is set to `Random`
RandomFlow.description_zh: 当实验组流量定向的类型是Random时，使用随机流量匹配这个实验组，可能的取值范围是 0 - 100

Status.description_en:
The status of the experiment group. Valid values:
● `Offline`: The experiment group is not launched.
● `Online`: The experiment group is launched.
● `Pushed`: The experiment group is fully launched
Status.description_zh:
实验组状态。
● Offline-未上线
● Online-已上线
● Pushed-已推全
Status.title_en:
